options.text: It is too slow or doesn't go where I need to go
It is unreliable or runs too rarely
Using it is tiring or physically difficult for me (steps, crowding, standing)
I feel unsafe on board or at stops (traffic, crime or harassment)

schema.text: Why do you rarely use public transport? (Select all that apply)

ar.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: أشعر بعدم الأمان على متنه أو في المحطات (المرور أو الجريمة أو التحرش)
ar.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: بطيء جدًا أو لا يذهب إلى حيث أحتاج
ar.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: استخدامه متعب أو صعب جسديًا بالنسبة لي (الدرجات، الازدحام، الوقوف)
ar.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: لماذا نادرًا ما تستخدم النقل العام؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)

de.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: Ich fühle mich im Fahrzeug oder an Haltestellen unsicher (Verkehr, Kriminalität oder Belästigung)
de.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: Sie sind zu langsam oder fahren nicht dorthin, wo ich hinmuss
de.#It is unreliable or runs too rarely: Sie sind unzuverlässig oder fahren zu selten
de.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: Die Nutzung ist für mich anstrengend oder körperlich schwierig (Stufen, Gedränge, Stehen)
de.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: Warum nutzen Sie selten öffentliche Verkehrsmittel? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)

en.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: I feel unsafe on board or at stops (traffic, crime or harassment)
en.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: It is too slow or doesn't go where I need to go
en.#It is unreliable or runs too rarely: It is unreliable or runs too rarely
en.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: Using it is tiring or physically difficult for me (steps, crowding, standing)
en.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: Why do you rarely use public transport? (Select all that apply)

fa.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: در داخل وسیله یا در ایستگاه‌ها احساس ناامنی می‌کنم (ترافیک، جرم یا آزار)
fa.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: خیلی کند است یا به جاهایی که باید بروم نمی‌رود
fa.#It is unreliable or runs too rarely: قابل‌اعتماد نیست یا دیر به دیر می‌آید
fa.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: استفاده از آن برای من خسته‌کننده یا از نظر جسمی دشوار است (پله، شلوغی، ایستادن)
fa.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: چرا به‌ندرت از حمل‌ونقل عمومی استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)

fr.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: Je ne me sens pas en sécurité à bord ou aux arrêts (circulation, délinquance ou harcèlement)
fr.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: Ils sont trop lents ou ne vont pas là où je dois aller
fr.#It is unreliable or runs too rarely: Ils sont peu fiables ou trop peu fréquents
fr.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: Les utiliser est fatigant ou physiquement difficile pour moi (marches, foule, rester debout)
fr.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: Pourquoi utilisez-vous rarement les transports en commun ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)

hu.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: A járműveken vagy a megállókban nem érzem magam biztonságban (forgalom, bűncselekmények vagy zaklatás)
hu.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: Túl lassú, vagy nem oda megy, ahová nekem mennem kell
hu.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: A használata fárasztó vagy fizikailag nehéz számomra (lépcsők, zsúfoltság, állás)
hu.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: Miért használja ritkán a tömegközlekedést? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)

it.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: A bordo o alle fermate non mi sento al sicuro (traffico, criminalità o molestie)
it.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: Sono troppo lenti o non vanno dove mi serve
it.#It is unreliable or runs too rarely: Sono inaffidabili o passano troppo di rado
it.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: Usarli è faticoso o fisicamente difficile per me (gradini, affollamento, stare in piedi)
it.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: Perché usi poco i mezzi pubblici? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)

tr.#I feel unsafe on board or at stops (tra: Araçta veya duraklarda kendimi güvende hissetmiyorum (trafik, suç veya taciz)
tr.#It is too slow or doesn't go where I ne: Çok yavaş veya gitmem gereken yere gitmiyor
tr.#Using it is tiring or physically diffic: Kullanmak benim için yorucu veya fiziksel olarak zor (basamaklar, kalabalık, ayakta durmak)
tr.#Why do you rarely use public transport?: Neden nadiren toplu taşıma kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
